comments.author: @TravelUnknown-1602
comments.text: Ecuador is fascinating because altitude changes almost everything—weather, farming, travel, and even the pace of daily life. I’d love to know what feels hardest about living so high in the Andes. Could you handle it long-term?

comments.author: @TravelHiddenWorlds
comments.text: What amazes me about Ecuador is how dramatically life changes with altitude—within the same country, people can live between tropical lowlands and some of the highest inhabited places on Earth. I’d love to know how much altitude shapes daily routines, food, and culture. Could you live that high?
